title: Generalization in Healthcare AI: Evaluation of a Clinical Large Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model predictive performance (AUC, AUPRC, ECE) on a 30-day readmission task across different patient insurance types (Government, Private/Commercial, Self-Pay, Other Specific).

Measuring the disparity in readmission prediction performance metrics across standard CDC-defined race categories (White, Black, Asian, American Indian or Alaska Native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander).
Comparing the model's predictive accuracy and calibration across four distinct patient age groups (Under 18, Young Adult 18-35, Adult 35-60, and Above 60).
Assessing the model's predictive performance across patients stratified into four severity levels based on their Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI).

Analyzing generalization and performance gaps in clinical outcome predictions across four different hospitals within the same healthcare system, correlating performance with sample size and hospital-specific characteristics.
